description: Re-queue a past webhook delivery to its endpoint. Clones the delivery into a fresh attempt, reusing the ORIGINAL event id — so a consumer that dedupes on X-Porkbun-Webhook-Id treats the resend as the same event. The endpoint must still exist and be ACTIVE. Use after fixing a downstream bug to replay a delivery that previously FAILED.

id.description: The delivery id to resend (from list_webhook_deliveries).

name: resend_webhook
title: Resend Webhook
